stratified_examples.question: I need to update the og:image for my entire site to ensure the correct image appears when the link is posted on social media. I also want to know if this will affect the image when the link is posted in an email or on Instagram.
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To update the og:image for your entire site:

- Go to your site's settings in the Wix Editor.
- Click "Website settings."
- Scroll down to "General social image" and click "Upload Image."
- Select or upload the desired image, then click "Choose File" and save.
- Publish your site to apply changes [S1].

Regarding the impact on image display:

- The og:image primarily controls the thumbnail shown when your site link is shared on social media platforms like Facebook and X.
- For email clients, the image display depends on the email service and how it handles link previews; og:image may or may not be used consistently.
- Instagram does not generate link previews with og:image, so the image will not appear automatically when posting links there.

Therefore, updating the og:image ensures consistent social media sharing thumbnails but may not affect email or Instagram link previews [S1, S2].

stratified_examples.question: Im unable to access the Google Maps element in the footer of my Wix site. Im having trouble removing it, and I dont know where the overlapping items feature is located.
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To access and remove the Google Maps element in your Wix site's footer when it's difficult to select:

- Open the Layers panel in the Wix Editor by clicking the Layers icon at the bottom of the editor. Navigate to the Footer section to locate the Google Maps element and select it directly from the list.
- Use the Overlapping Items feature by right-clicking on the element that is covering the Google Maps element. Then hover over "Overlapping Items" in the context menu and select the Google Maps element from the submenu.
- If the Overlapping Items feature does not work, right-click the covering element, hover over "Arrange," and select "Move Backward" repeatedly until the Google Maps element becomes accessible.
- Alternatively, use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + M (Cmd + Shift + M on Mac) to toggle through the elements on the page until the Google Maps element is selected.

These steps will help you locate and remove the Google Maps element even if it is hidden behind other elements or outside the gridlines [S1][S2].

stratified_examples.gt_answer:
If you are unable to select or find an element in the editor, it is possible that it has been placed behind another element. Follow the steps below to locate and select your elements in the editor.

## Use the Layers panel to locate an element
If an element is placed outside the editor gridlines or behind another element, you may not be able to see it on your screen. Use the Layers panel to locate the element on the page.
## To open the Layers panel and find elements:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Layers** icon ![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/gK9dfcU80SWT9YOMhPhN62hW4YUDMmaf17w7O0LfSHLFn46W1Nugy_36zibPxclwtc5OmziXxiJ-zGwzz956EAjx8MqPYVd_i7KRCOZU9Sq7-7KUE-tjh3C5Lhgyto4oz9h2J5E5-59p__W4gjiJwg) at the bottom of your editor.
3. Click **Header**, **Page** or **Footer**.
4. Find the relevant element on the list and click to select it.

## Use Ctrl + Shift + M to toggle through your elements
If you see an element on your live site or in Preview mode, but not in the editor, it might be placed outside of the site's gridlines. Toggle through your page elements to locate the element.
To toggle through elements on a page:
1. Hold down Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) + Shift on your keyboard.
2. Press M to scroll through the elements on your site until you reach the desired element.

stratified_examples.question: Im unable to access the Google Maps element in the footer of my Wix site. Im having trouble removing it, and I dont know where the overlapping items feature is located.
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To access and remove the Google Maps element in your Wix site's footer when it's difficult to select:

- Open the Layers panel in the Wix Editor by clicking the Layers icon at the bottom of the editor. Navigate to the Footer section to locate the Google Maps element and select it directly from the list.
- Use the Overlapping Items feature by right-clicking on the element that is covering the Google Maps element. Then hover over "Overlapping Items" in the context menu and select the Google Maps element from the submenu.
- If the Overlapping Items feature does not work, right-click the covering element, hover over "Arrange," and select "Move Backward" repeatedly until the Google Maps element becomes accessible.
- Alternatively, use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + M (Cmd + Shift + M on Mac) to toggle through the elements on the page until the Google Maps element is selected.

These steps will help you locate and remove the Google Maps element even if it is hidden behind other elements or outside the gridlines [S1][S2].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:

To open the Layers panel, find element and delete it:
1. Go to your [editor] (https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the Layers icon  at the bottom of your editor.
3. Click Header, Page or Footer.
4. Find the relevant element on the list and click to select it.
5. Press Delete on your keyboard.

  If you see an element on your live site or in Preview mode, but not in the Editor, it might be placed outside of the site's gridlines. Toggle through your page elements to locate the element.
  To toggle through elements on a page:
  Hold down Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) + Shift on your keyboard.
  Press M to scroll through the elements on your site until you reach the desired element.

When your header or footer are frozen, you may be unable to select an element. You can unfreeze the header and footer by selecting a new scroll setting, or disabling the Freeze option.
To unfreeze your footer:
1. Click the footer.
2. Click the Settings icon .
3. Click the Freeze Footer toggle to disable it.
